title: Peer attachment fetch: proxy-fetch blobs from sender on download
description:
When Alice downloads an attachment from a message Bob sent her, Alice's kithd must fetch the blob bytes from Bob's kithd and cache them locally. Currently kithd stores only attachment metadata at Peer/deliver time; the download endpoint returns 404 for any inbound attachment blob.

Scope:
1. Download handler: when blob not found locally, look up sender from the attachment's message, fetch from peer's downloadUrl, cache, serve
2. kith-store: query to find sender contact by blobId (via message → contact join)
3. kith-peer/fetch.rs: HTTP client to GET blob from remote kithd over tailnet (reuse TailnetCertVerifier; authenticate with TLS + tailnet identity)
4. kith-attach: check-exists + store-fetched helpers
5. Error handling: peer unreachable → 502 with Retry-After; blob hash mismatch → 500; size limit enforcement
